messages:
maya: Hey team — Fjord (AE: @matt) wants to run a POC for a customer using Lumen-XL-2.1. They want to validate both the FP16 and an INT8 quantized variant across Dedicated + Private. Target: p50 token latency <80ms, p99 under 250ms, seq len 2048. Any model onboarding blockers we should flag?

sam: Quick checklist before we commit: model format (PyTorch/transformers/ggml), tokenizer files, model_config.json, param count, and whether the quantized artifacts are standard bnb exports. Also need an eval prompt set and expected QPS.

maya: I have a private HF repo (will share URL + collaborator invite) and quantized checkpoints in S3. I'll DM creds. License is Apache-2.0 but customer wants confirmation about commercial use.

sam: Ping me the HF URL & S3 creds. Run the compatibility scan locally first:

```bash
# run our local scanner
rwd-cli model scan --path ./lumen-xl-2.1 --out ./scan-report.json
```

sam: The scanner will flag missing tokenizer files and nonstandard bnb ops; if it returns green we can produce a single config that works for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

dina: Heads up on pricing: if they need reserved Dedicated GPUs with 24/7 capacity that will push to committed pricing (monthly). Quantized CPU inference on Private could reduce infra costs but may not hit latency targets. Ballpark uplift for 13B-class with 80ms p50 = +20% on top of baseline reserved rate. Need QPS to firm up. :moneybag:

jordan: From infra POV — what’s the param count? if it's >20B we need 80GB GPU; 9–20B usually fits on 48GB with int8. Also tell us max batch size and whether they plan multi-sequence batching.

maya: Lumen-XL-2.1 is ~13B, seq 2048, customer expects ~8–12 QPS during peak, single-token streaming. I'll attach the model card and sample prompts here (sending via DM).

ops-bot: scan started for model lumen-xl-2.1 at 1915000123

ops-bot: scan complete — format: transformers (OK), tokenizer.json (MISSING), kv-cache support (OK), quantized checkpoints: custom bnb format (WARN). Recommendation: re-export int8 using `transformers` + `bitsandbytes` or provide a standard GGML/pt-int8 build. See notes in /scans/lumen-xl-2.1-report.txt.

sam: Thanks — tokenizer missing is an easy fix. The custom bnb warning means we should re-export or we might need a small adapter in the runtime. For Private we can ship an adapter but Dedicated/Hosted prefer standard bnb artifacts.

maya: I'll ask the customer to re-export with the standard bnb flow. Also they sent a security questionnaire (SOC2 + SSO SAML). Dina — can you lead security + license replies?

dina: On it. I'll coordinate with security and legal. I'll also draft a short SOW addendum for quantization support and list assumptions about latency. Expect initial reply by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

sam: Next steps for engineering: once we have HF link + S3 creds + re-exported quant checkpoints I'll re-run the scan and produce two config snippets (one tuned for Dedicated, one for Private) and a perf estimate.

jordan: After Sam posts the perf estimate tag me — I'll map to GPU SKUs and provide a costed infra plan (including fallback policies if capacity is constrained).

maya: Great — thanks all. I'll follow up with the HF invite and S3 creds shortly and copy in the customer for next-week POC kickoff. :rocket:

ops-bot: thread archived to sales-poc-tracker at 1915000400
